綿の港を調べていたら、南極とごま油と砲台が出てきた

Cotton Harbor sounds soft, but this Yokohama waterfront once housed a ship-repair dock that transformed Soya into an Antarctic research vessel. 1939 city records contain the name 棉花町; a nearby park preserves traces of an 1860 coastal battery; a sesame-oil factory remains. 史料・開発発表・現況を照合し、名前と都市の記憶を読み直す。
